post.description:
Negotiate a WebRTC peer connection. WHEP-style stateless offer/answer.

The video track is hardware-encoded H.264 piped from the VPU. Overlays
(detections, servo crosshair, exclusion zones) are sent separately over
the /ws/events WebSocket and drawn client-side.

patch.description: Update WebRTC stream settings. In-memory only; resets on restart.

get.description: Live system metrics: CPU, memory, temperatures, accelerator state, network.

post.description: Discard the MOG2 background model so it relearns the current scene.

get.description: Return current tuning values so the frontend can initialise its controls.

patch.description: Update servo aim configuration and persist to database.

get.description: Return the list of all detectable YOLO class names.
Return current system status (FPS + servo position).

post.description: Manually command both servos to explicit angles (debug / calibration mode).

patch.description: Update event-triggered recording configuration and persist to DB.

get.description:
Return recent event-triggered clips and clear the queue.

The frontend polls this endpoint; each clip is returned only once.

patch.description: Update splash configuration and persist to database.

get.description: Return live splash state for the frontend indicator.

post.description: Manually fire the pump after the configured delay, then cooldown.
